author: Yffe
content: Ship audit manifest v1 + forge audit as a PURE PROJECTION over the existing per-fn Certificate collection + AssuranceManifest::aggregate. New module forge/src/audit.rs: AuditManifest { manifest_version v1, functions[] (FunctionRow), project_assurance (ProjectAssuranceSection embedding the #10/#17 aggregate), tcb (Tcb = SlagBlock U BoundaryContract U Toolchain) }. forge audit verb in cli.rs runs check::check_file (default config, no re-verification) and emits --json or a human summary. TCB completeness (R-DEFER-9): every cert.slag + cert.boundary enumerated, toolchain always present. Verified against conformance/audit/cases.json (corpus_empty_tcb, slag_boundary_tcb).
